## Open-source repositories

- [claw-consensus](https://github.com/tonydzi/claw-consensus) — multi-machine agent consensus (propose/counter/accept/commit), dual-rail bus, ACK discipline, self-healing sync. Offline demo, documented failure modes. MIT.
- [verbatim-citation-gate](https://github.com/tonydzi/verbatim-citation-gate) — catch fabricated RAG citations before they reach the user: zero-token verbatim gate plus a burden-of-proof judge, framework-agnostic. MIT.
- [agent-leash](https://github.com/tonydzi/agent-leash) — LEASH-8, an 8-domain control model for AI agents with delegated authority: scorecard, approval-design checklist, plan-vs-authorize pattern. MIT.
- [claude-bible](https://github.com/tonydzi/claude-bible) — rules-as-files governance for Claude Code: precedence, declined-decisions journal, objection sparring. MIT.
- [sqlite-graph-memory](https://github.com/tonydzi/sqlite-graph-memory) — graph RAG on SQLite: vector retrieval, curated wikilink graph, cross-encoder rerank, zero-token per-turn memory ledger. MIT.
- [charm-os](https://github.com/tonydzi/charm-os) — framework to manage humans and AI agents as first-class relationships on a personal second brain, driven by the RDR loop. Apache-2.0.
- [second-brain-starter-kit](https://github.com/tonydzi/second-brain-starter-kit) — Claude Code as a second brain: skills, a working CRM engine, vault templates, handover map. Method, not data.
- [clawrush](https://github.com/tonydzi/clawrush) — the English build-in-public diary, longreads and reusable artifacts.
- [the-journey](https://tonydzi.github.io/the-journey/) — a build-in-public book of a founder plus AI collaboration, human and machine readable.
- [cofounder](https://tonydzi.github.io/cofounder/) — the lab's open co-founder call and application form.
